Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first turn (Step 1), the WebSurfer agent hallucinated a fact. It claimed that a search result found an infobox indicating "Selim II — Nationality: Venetian." This is historically incorrect; Selim II was an Ottoman Sultan. Furthermore, the provided text from the actual DuckDuckGo search results visible in the conversation shows Wikipedia results stating Gevherhan was an "Ottoman princess" and the daughter of "Sultan Selim II," with no mention of Venetian nationality. The agent fabricated a contradictory source to create an error scenario that subsequent agents tried to fix.
